tools.name: npm-packages

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hacker-news, us-weather-forecast · Private data: polymarket, hacker-news, arxiv-papers, openalex-papers, sec-edgar, earthquake-events, us-weather-forecast, pypi-packages, npm-packages, ecb-fx-rates, web-snapshot, domain-intel, software-support-lookup, browser-feature-lookup, unicode-confusable-lookup · Public sink: ecb-fx-rates · Destructive: list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hacker-news, us-weather-forecast · Private data: polymarket, hacker-news, arxiv-papers, openalex-papers, sec-edgar, earthquake-events, us-weather-forecast, pypi-packages, npm-packages, ecb-fx-rates, web-snapshot, domain-intel, software-support-lookup, browser-feature-lookup, unicode-confusable-lookup · Public sink: ecb-fx-rates · Destructive: list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
